context: replica — same-design migration with a measured source-fidelity gate. Task and setup in task.md; each item is judged pass/fail and weighted by max_score.

checklist.name: extract_prep_unmodified
checklist.description: stardust:extract --prep runs unchanged and produces the standard stardust/current/ artifacts (pages/*.json, screenshots, brand extraction, descriptive PRODUCT/DESIGN specs); no extract file or behavior is modified A bounded entry (--single / --pages) still leaves stardust/current/_brand-extraction.json with `_provenance.mode: "bounded"` (brand-surface.mjs --bounded), which Phase 2's bounded promotion branch reads as a real file — never a synthesized spec.

checklist.name: mechanical_promotion_no_direct
checklist.description: The target spec at the project root is a verbatim promotion of stardust/current/{PRODUCT,DESIGN}.{md,json}; stardust/direction.md records preserve mode; stardust:direct is never invoked and no divergence/palette/type re-selection occurs.

checklist.name: inconsistency_register
checklist.description: stardust/replica/inconsistency-register.md exists; it is empty when no findings are supplied, and any entry carries captured evidence, the minimal change, and a status (applied/deferred). No design delta appears in the prototype without a register entry.

checklist.name: clean_reauthoring
checklist.description: Archetype prototypes are clean re-authored HTML/CSS: semantic structure, tokenized CSS with values traceable to the source site's own stylesheets, no copied DOM/class-soup/framework artifacts, content verbatim from the captured page JSON; images reference the harvested copies (`images[].localPath` under stardust/current/assets/media/), never the source CDN URL — a `downloadError` entry is the one public-URL case and is listed in the brief.

checklist.name: css_lift_recorded
checklist.description: Fidelity values come from `node stardust/scripts/replica/lift.mjs <live> --width <w> [--save-css]` per gate width (stardust/replica/capture/lift/, capture/css/), cited in the prototype CSS — never eyeballed; the lift artefact is named in the Phase 3 evidence and in progress.json.modules[] for each module kind.

checklist.name: source_fidelity_gate_runs
checklist.description: The source-fidelity gate runs all three probes (content-diff and visual-diff with --profile generic against the live URL, plus stitch-shot + pixel-compare) and its evidence (per-iteration metrics, band breakdown, height delta, diff images) is written under stardust/replica/.

checklist.name: chrome_states_probed
checklist.description: After the static pass the chrome state matrix is probed with `node stardust/scripts/replica/chrome-states.mjs <live> [<proto>] --from-state stardust/state.json --live-cache` (one live navigation, cached), every cell gated or a named residual; the approval message names the matrix; no state word or crop result appears that the probe did not record.

checklist.name: chrome_archetype_gated
checklist.description: One gated chrome archetype row per chrome variant (progress.json.chrome, chrome-variants.mjs --progress exit 0) before any page of that variant fans out; a second variant opens the `chrome-variant` decision row (template body class or nav:/footer: document, never page-local CSS); an unrowed variant's pages are not rendered, migrated or deployed in the session.

checklist.name: served_identity_owned
checklist.description: Prototypes are served through `serve.mjs --role proto` on the project's allocated slot (port.mjs proto, 8800–8899 — never a typed 8791); every gate round asserts the served identity (gate.sh --marker / served-identity.mjs, exit 4 = no verdict, never a FAIL); a foreign listener is listed, never killed.

checklist.name: both_breakpoints_gated
checklist.description: The gate runs at both 1440 and 360; mobile results are recorded, not assumed from desktop.

checklist.name: iteration_discipline
checklist.description: At most 3 measured iterations per breakpoint; unresolved deltas are logged as residuals rather than silently accepted or endlessly iterated.

checklist.name: motion_record_before_approval
checklist.description: Before approval is requested for an archetype, stardust/replica/progress.json carries motion.{observed,implemented,dead} for it and, per gated breakpoint, breakpoints.<bp>.motion.assert written by skills/replica/scripts/motion-assert.mjs --record (verdict pass|fail|n/a|none, regime, target) — the transcript shows the script ran against the PROTOTYPE URL, never the live origin. A missing record is reported as `motion: unasserted` in the Phase 4 close, never approved over; a fail verdict is iterated or logged as a residual, not deleted.

checklist.name: font_policy
checklist.description: Fonts are loaded from the same public source or substituted with a metric-matched free face; no commercial/licensed kit is rehosted; the brand family stays first in the font stack.

checklist.name: standard_handoff
checklist.description: Archetypes land at stardust/prototypes/<slug>-proposed.html and page lifecycle lives in core state.json, so migrate/deploy/rollout consume them without modification.

checklist.name: provenance
checklist.description: Captured artifacts carry live-render provenance; no synthesized content or invented sections appear anywhere in the recreation.
